onboarding.title: Welcome

language.title: Choose your interface language
language.subtitle: You can change it later in your profile.

level.title: How good is your Spanish?
level.subtitle: Pick the level that feels closest. It only tunes your recommendations.

mic.title: You'll answer with your voice
mic.body: Short Spanish videos pause right before the next word or an answer. Say it out loud and we'll check it. We use the microphone only while you answer. Audio is not stored.
mic.denied: Microphone access was blocked. You can still type your answers.
mic.unsupported: This browser can't access the microphone here. Open the app over HTTPS.

onboarding.saveFailed: Couldn't save your answers. Try again.

lessons.title: Series
lessons.subtitle: Short Spanish videos. When one pauses, say the next word or the answer.

player.title: Video
player.unclear: Didn't catch that. Say it once more.
player.micDenied: Microphone is blocked. Type your answer instead.
player.micError: Couldn't record. Try again or type the answer.

result.title: Lesson result
result.noResult: You haven't finished this lesson yet.

partial.title: Nice work
partial.body: Most words landed. Replay the video to catch the rest.

missed.title: Keep going
missed.body: These were tricky. Look at the words below and try the video again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.goalPlaceholder: Where are you going and why?
profile.subtitlesHint: Pick one or more languages. Spanish is the original audio.

mic.title: Microphone
mic.hint: Records 3 seconds and plays them back. Nothing is uploaded.
mic.denied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in the browser site settings.
mic.unsupported: Microphone isn't available in this browser or over plain HTTP.

reset.title: Reset progress?
reset.body: All completed lessons will be cleared. Your settings stay.

social.noComments: No comments yet. Be the first!

auth.modeLabel: Sign in or create an account
auth.name: Name

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.subtitle: Save your progress and keep learning Spanish with short videos.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to continue where you left off.

errors.weakPassword: Password must be at least {{min}} characters.
errors.googleFailed: Couldn't sign in with Google. Try again.
errors.signUpRejected: Couldn't create the account. Check your email and use a stronger password: upper- and lowercase letters, a digit and a symbol.
errors.signUpLoginFailed: This email may already be registered. Try signing in instead.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.serverUnavailable: The server is waking up. Try again in a minute.

auth.skipHint: You can use the app without an account and sign in later in your profile.
auth.guestBody: Sign in to keep your progress safe.

prompt.text: Sign in to keep your progress and likes.
